title: 2.1.6 Write Your First if
description: Write an if statement that logs a message when a number meets a threshold. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice for 'The if Statement', book 2.1.1

steps.title: Declare a number variable
steps.instructions: Create a variable called score and assign it a number value of your choice.

steps.title: Write an if statement
steps.instructions: Write an if statement that checks whether score is greater than or equal to 70. Inside the if block, use console.log to print a message saying the score passes.
